listings.Job Description: A graduate surveyor specialising in valuations for loan security and financial reporting. The surveyor will work with a wide range of clients including local, international and private banks, private wealth customers, local and international companies and Government Departments. The role is based out of Dubai although will be expected to work across the U.A.E. and potentially wider Middle East region occasionally. The ideal candidate will be wishing to pursue, or currently pursuing the APC, towards qualification as a member of the RICS.
listings.Job Requirements: Educated to Bachelor’s degree and/or Masters level (RICS Accredited); Excellent communication skills; Driving license holder (UAE); Have a sound business knowledge especially within this market sector; Has broad knowledge of principles and practices of related disciplines; Understands what generates revenue and makes profit; Strong persuasive and negotiation skills; Excellent reporting and organizational skills; Proactive and excellent team player; Based in the UAE or willing to relocate.
